self_assessment: paymentTokenHelper.tsx now exports a VerifyPayment type (({ mode, Payment, Token, ApprovalURL, ReturnHost }) => Promise<TokenPaymentMethod>), and createPaymentToken takes verify in place of createModal: on STATUS_CHARGEABLE it still returns toTokenPaymentMethod(Token) immediately without calling verify, otherwise it returns verify({ mode, Payment, Token, ApprovalURL, ReturnHost }); the PaymentVerificationModal rendering and its resolve/reject/onProcess handlers were lifted out of it, and the Payment local is now declared CardPayment | undefined. Added getCreatePaymentToken(verify), which returns a function with the call shape ({ mode, api, params }, amountAndCurrency?) that delegates to createPaymentToken with verify pre-bound, and getDefaultVerifyPayment(createModal, api), which internally defines the async verify that mounts PaymentVerificationModal with mode/payment/token and drives process() through an AbortController. PaymentStep, PayInvoiceModal, CreditsModal, EditCardModal and SubscriptionModal each now build const verify = getDefaultVerifyPayment(createModal, api) and const createPaymentToken = getCreatePaymentToken(verify) and no longer pass createModal into the call; single-signup/Step1.tsx was updated the same way (using its normalApi) since it is the remaining caller and would otherwise not compile, even though the requirements list omits it. process() and its polling/abort semantics were left byte-identical. Verified: standalone tsc over all seven changed files reports exactly the same 18 pre-existing errors as the clean base (all from the absent node_modules), so no new type errors; jest could not be run because installing the monorepo's dependencies needs registry/git access the proxy blocks.
